description: Structured-output shape for one edge-case-hunter review call, matching contract.json's review-diff responseDescriptor (requiredKeys ok+findings). edge-case-hunter.md's own prompt asks for a bare JSON array, but claude -p --json-schema requires a top-level object (the API rejects an array-typed tool schema), so the array is wrapped under `findings` and `ok` records whether the review ran to completion.

ok.description: true unless a halt condition fired (empty/undecodable input).

findings.description: edge-case-hunter's own four required fields, plus the two optional fields its deletion/claims passes add.

location.description: file:line or file:start-end (numeric line or line-range only -- the driver's matcher does not parse a bare hunk identifier).

kind.description: Present only on a Step 4 deletion finding or a Step 5 claims finding.
